image_description: A close-up shot of a colorful, chunky beaded necklace displayed on a white mannequin bust. The necklace features large, textured beads in various colors (pink, blue, purple, red) that appear to be wrapped in thread or yarn. A large, heart-shaped pendant with similar multicolored thread-wrapped texture hangs at the center. The background is a plain, light-colored wall.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the 'thread-wrapped' beads has a slightly smudged or painterly quality typical of AI generation. Individual fibers are not sharply defined, appearing more like soft, blended color patches than distinct threads.

The string or cord connecting the beads is largely invisible or appears to melt into the beads themselves. In a real physical object, there would be visible gaps or a clear string thread between the large beads.
The geometry of the mannequin is slightly unnatural; the transition from neck to shoulder is overly smooth and lacks realistic anatomical definition or sharp edges, appearing slightly warped.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is classified as a necklace and potentially identify the specific style (e.g., statement necklace, beaded necklace).
To check if the beads are distinct, separate objects or if they fuse together (melting), and to verify the boundary between the necklace and the mannequin.
To assess the overall realism of the textures (thread wrapping) and lighting, looking for subtle AI artifacts like inconsistent shadows or noise patterns.

focus_areas: Connectivity of beads (is there a visible string/cord?)
Texture realism of the thread-wrapped beads
Boundary separation between necklace and mannequin skin
Structural integrity of the pendant attachment
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'string' holding the beads. AI often fails to render the thin cord connecting large beads, resulting in floating or fused beads. Also, evaluate if the 'thread' texture looks like actual wound fiber or just noisy color blobs.
